## wrkq.project-root.caller-semantics

- **scope:** project-root path/selector scoping across CLI surfaces
- **predicate:** All path/selector-taking CLI commands (legacy internal/cli AND the RPC-backed mirror internal/rpccli) must transform raw user arguments through the neutral internal/projectroot implementation BEFORE constructing RPC params or store lookups: raw args + config.Load project-root precedence (WRKQ_PROJECT_ROOT / ASP_PROJECT / .env.local / config.yaml) + --project override (resolved against the DB) + per-command defaultToRoot + ID/UUID/sequence/`t:`/`c:`-prefix exemptions -> effective selector/path RPC methods receive ONLY effective selectors/paths. They must NOT inspect WRKQ_PROJECT_ROOT, ASP_PROJECT, or --project — project-root scoping is caller semantics, not a server read-model concern. There is exactly ONE implementation of this transform; the legacy CLI and rpccli may wrap it but must not fork it.
- **enforced_by:** `internal/projectroot (single source of truth) + rpccli scoper call sites`
- **source:** `internal/projectroot/projectroot.go`, `internal/rpccli/scope.go`, `internal/cli/project_root.go`, `internal/cli/appctx/appctx.go`
- **required_tests:** `internal/projectroot/projectroot_test.go`, `internal/rpccli/parity_test.go`, `internal/rpccli/importguard_test.go`
- **last_verified:** 2026-06-22

## wrkq.wrkf-rpc.stdout-purity

- **scope:** wrkf RPC stdio transport
- **predicate:** the wrkf RPC server's stdout carries only well-formed JSON-RPC frames; no handler may write non-protocol bytes to stdout (logs/diagnostics go to stderr).
